update_tensor_inplace: update a destination tensor in-place with data from a source tensor, matching shape and stride
replace_parameter: replace a registered nn.Module parameter with a new tensor, using in-place update or re-registration
refactor_update_tensor_inplace: refactor update_tensor_inplace to safely handle dtype mismatches and storage differences
review_replace_parameter: review replace_parameter to ensure torch.compile compatibility when re-registering parameters
test_replace_parameter: test replace_parameter with matching and mismatching dtype, shape, and storage scenarios
